# Magnolia By The Sea

> Waterfront luxury vacation rental in Indian Rocks Beach, Florida

## Property Overview

Magnolia By The Sea is a professionally managed waterfront vacation home located on the Intracoastal Waterway in Indian Rocks Beach, Florida. The property sleeps 10 guests across 4 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms. It features a heated saltwater pool, private dock, rooftop deck, 2 kayaks, and an included 6-passenger golf cart for beach access (2 minutes to the beach).

## Key Facts

- Location: Indian Rocks Beach, FL (Gulf Coast, Pinellas County)
- Bedrooms: 4 (Waterfront Balcony Room, Poolside Room, Private Retreat, Bunk Haven)
- Bathrooms: 3
- Sleeps: 10 guests
- Rating: 5.0 stars from 56 verified guest reviews
- Designation: Airbnb Guest Favorite, Top 10% of Homes
- Registration: BTR# 2302
- Property Manager: Florida Dreamscape Vacation Rentals

## Rooms

- Waterfront Balcony Room: King bed, private balcony overlooking the Intracoastal, access to rooftop deck
- Poolside Room: King bed, patio doors leading directly to the heated pool and backyard
- Private Retreat: King bed, vaulted ceiling, ensuite access to upstairs bathroom
- Bunk Haven: 4 custom built-in Twin XL bunk beds with USB outlets and personal LED lights

## Amenities

- Heated saltwater pool (year-round)
- Private dock with direct Intracoastal access
- 2 kayaks with kayak launch
- 6-passenger golf cart (included)
- Rooftop deck with fire pit
- Tesla EV charger
- 1Gbps WiFi
- Nespresso machine
- Weber grill and outdoor dining
- Covered outdoor dining area
- Outdoor shower
- Washer and dryer
- Pack and play and high chair available

## Policies

- No pets allowed
- No smoking allowed
- Check-in: 4:00 PM, Check-out: 10:00 AM
- Primary renter must be 21 or older
- Minimum stay: usually 3 nights
- Cancellation: full refund at least 30 days before check-in; partial refund 7-30 days before check-in

## Parking & Access

- Large circular driveway fits 4-5 cars
- Golf cart has its own parking spot, plus dedicated golf cart parking at the beach
- Lower-level bedrooms, bathrooms, and bunk room are 3 steps down from the main living area

## Seasonality

- Busiest months: March through August
- Best weather: October and November
- Thanksgiving, Christmas, and New Year's often book far in advance

## Distances

- Indian Rocks Beach: 8-minute walk or 2 minutes by golf cart

- Busch Gardens Tampa Bay: 45 minutes

- Walmart and Target: 10 minutes by car
